texto: «das» or «welches» is never used after these elements:

filas: Alles, was er vorschlägt, ist sinnvoll.
Es gibt nichts, was mich beunruhigt.
Ich suche etwas, was langlebig ist.
I'm looking for something that's lasting.
Das, was du sagst, überzeugt mich.
Das ist das Beste, was passieren konnte.
It's the best thing that could happen.

texto: As in any German subordinate clause, «was» opens the subordinate introduced by coma and the conjugated verb is moved to the last position.

frases.de: Wir haben alles besprochen, was für das neue Quartal entscheidend ist.
frases.es: Hemos tratado todo lo que es decisivo para el nuevo trimestre.
frases.en: We have dealt with everything that is decisive for the new quarter.

frases.de: Gibt es wirklich nichts, was die Einführung verzögern könnte?
frases.es: ¿De verdad no hay nada que pudiera retrasar el lanzamiento?
frases.en: Is there really nothing that could delay the launch?
analisis: nichts, was die Einführung verzögern könnte
nothing that could delay the launch

frases.de: Das, was der Abteilungsleiter vorgelegt hat, deckt alle Risiken ab.
frases.es: Aquello que el jefe de departamento ha presentado cubre todos los riesgos.
frases.en: That which the head of department has presented covers all the risks.
analisis: Das, was der Abteilungsleiter vorgelegt hat
what the head of department has presented

frases.de: Das ist das Beste, was wir unter diesen Umständen tun können.
frases.es: Es lo mejor que podemos hacer bajo estas circunstancias.
frases.en: It's the best we can do under these circumstances.

bloques.pregunta: Why should «was» and not «das» be used in the «Alles, was er vorschlägt, ist sinnvoll» sentence?

opciones.texto: Porque tras pronombres indefinidos neutros como «alles» la gramática alemana exige el relativo «was».
opciones.explicacion: «alles, nichts, etwas, vieles» consistently claim the «was» pronoun.

opciones.texto: Because «was» can only be used in direct object questions.
opciones.explicacion: In this context «was» acts as a free relative pronoun or generalizer.

opciones.texto: Because «das» is only allowed when the main verb is in the compound past.
opciones.explicacion: The verbal time of the main verb does not alter the selection of the indefinite neutral relative.

bloques.frase: Wir haben über nichts gesprochen, ___ die Verhandlungen gefährden könnte.

opciones.explicacion: The indefinite negative antecedent «nichts» requires the relative pronoun «was».
«das» is incorrect after the indefinite negative pronoun «nichts».
«welches» is not used as a relative after neutral indefinite quantifiers.

bloques.pregunta: What is the precise meaning of this statement?
bloques.frase: Das, was du mir gestern erklärt hast, leuchtet mir vollkommen ein.

opciones.texto: Aquello que me explicaste ayer me resulta totalmente comprensible y convincente.
opciones.explicacion: «einleuchten» means to be obvious or convincing to someone.

opciones.texto: Everything you told me yesterday is completely out of logic.
opciones.explicacion: The «leuchtet ein» expression affirms the clarity and logic of the message, not its falsehood.

opciones.texto: The instructions you wrote yesterday were misplaced during the shipment.
opciones.explicacion: It does not refer to misguided documents but to the understanding of the above.

bloques.frase: Das ist das Interessanteste, ___ ich in dieser Fachzeitschrift gelesen habe.

opciones.explicacion: The «was» relative is governed by the subservient adjectives in neutral superlative («das Interessanteste»).
The substantial neutral superlative rejects «das» as a subordinate relative.
«dem» is dative and the direct complement position in the subordinate requires neutral accusative «was».

bloques.pregunta: What precedent does the relative «was» require, as opposed to «der, die, das»?

opciones.explicacion: After global indefinite pronouns such as «etwas», «alles» or «nichts», only «was» is used.
Specific gender-specific nouns require relative conformants (der, die, da).
It is a specific feminine noun that governs the «die» form.

bloques.frase: Alles, was er vorschlägt, ist sinnvoll
bloques.explicacion: «alles» as antecedent, relative «was» and subordinate verb «vorschlägt» at the end.

bloques.pregunta: Choose the formulation that strictly meets the standard for relative sentences with indefinite neutral history:

opciones.texto: Es gibt vieles, was wir noch gründlich analysieren müssen.
opciones.explicacion: «vieles» requires the «was» pronoun and the «analysieren müssen» verbal group closes the subordinate.

opciones.texto: Es gibt vieles, das wir müssen noch gründlich analysieren.
opciones.explicacion: It misuses «das» and alters the order of the subordinate modal verb.

opciones.texto: Es gibt vieles, was analysieren wir noch gründlich müssen.
opciones.explicacion: The order of the subordinate clause incorrectly places the verb in second position.

intro: When the antecedent of a relative sentence is not a noun with a given gender, but an indefinite, neutral generalizer pronoun (**alles**, **etwas**, **nichts**, **vieles**, **das**) or a substantial adjective in neutral superlative (**das Beste**, **das Neueste**), the relative pronoun **was** is required.
